response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE c.cnt > o.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: A rental transaction is a row in the rental table; each is linked to one film via inventory, and the overall average is the unweighted mean of the 5 per-rating counts.
